mapper.sql: select m.message_id, m.petition_id, m.receipt_lookup, m.sender, m.sender_name, m.content, m.read_flag, m.create_time, p.title as petition_title, p.status as petition_status from jc_petition_message m left join jc_petition p on p.petition_id = m.petition_id
mapper.insert: insert into jc_petition_message (petition_id, receipt_lookup, sender, sender_name, content, read_flag, create_time) values (#{petitionId}, #{receiptLookup}, #{sender}, #{senderName}, #{content}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.select: where m.petition_id = #{petitionId} order by m.create_time asc, m.message_id asc
where m.receipt_lookup = #{receiptLookup} order by m.create_time asc, m.message_id asc
mapper.update: update jc_petition_message set read_flag = '1' where petition_id = #{petitionId} and sender = #{sender} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from jc_petition_message where petition_id = #{petitionId} and sender = #{sender} and read_flag = '0'
select m.petition_id as petitionId, count(*) as unread from jc_petition_message m where m.sender = 'reporter' and m.read_flag = '0' group by m.petition_id
